## Summary

Bible neighborhood inspection can omit a live linked entity outside the renderer's 200-node prefix. Add explicit **Recall related story facts** in the selected Bible entity inspector and `ReadBibleRecall` using one shared domain read: exact anchor, up to 8 live one-hop neighbors, 32 typed paths and a 32 KiB evidence envelope.

Resolved fields retain baseline/snapshot source identities and revisions. Optional fictional time, unresolved facts, untimed relationships and omissions are explicit. Bible edits revoke displayed/outstanding recall evidence; selection, session, query, request-order and version guards refuse stale results. Existing manual text, draft and targeted preview/accept owners remain intact.

Exact current source: `4c468d6386bcad44117fe7e4439202cdde52a0f7`, tree `6f546f9d75bffe6baef70912f7635996f6acb244`. This lifecycle repair directly succeeds `8bd0da0daa22897996b8e60976bf2de63fffe4eb`; publication is a normal fast-forward. The original recall merge combines `14f7575` and accepted main `c4587c1`.

Inspector ownership now preserves shared recall evidence when one of multiple mounted inspectors closes. Final disposal revokes outstanding work without inventing a Facts changed notice; genuine mutation invalidation and its revision floor survive same-anchor remount. Late success/error cannot republish after final disposal. Query changes revoke work without claiming a canonical mutation. The stores README table also has the correct two-column structure.

## Decision Traceability (Required)

### Problem

Renderer-selected prefixes and hierarchy depth do not provide incident-edge recall with resolved field evidence for far linked peers. The existing Bible edit/targeted-preview/explicit-accept workflow already works; this fills the documented read gap.

### Constraints

Reuse SQLite, temporal resolution, sparse history and field/name/relationship lineage. Preserve renderer selection, generation context, canonical history, saved screenplay and drafts. Bound evidence and retain explicit temporal/provenance uncertainty. No new embedding or persistence dependency.

### Decision

One projection owns live one-hop selection, directed/custom-kind filtering, stable caps, whole-field omissions and atomic value/source/version capture. Native UI and agent read tools share it. A disposable UI cache owns inspection freshness; existing proposal/acceptance mechanisms retain replacement authority.

### Alternatives Rejected

- Reusing the renderer prefix leaves linked endpoints omitted.
- Automatic generation-context expansion changes consumption and authoring scope.
- A parallel memory/revision store duplicates existing custody; exact-ID graph recall needs no embedding dependency.

### Invariants Impacted

- Reads write no canon, history, dependencies, context links, proposals or screenplay.
- Unspecified/future/cleared temporal facts are withheld; conflicts refuse. Connectedness does not establish truth or timed edge validity.
- Exact source receipts and the Bible revision envelope come from one SQLite snapshot.
- Manual text and unrelated drafts remain authoritative; explicit acceptance alone replaces saved screenplay.

### Simplicity Review

Selection, bounds, temporal values and source custody belong to the shared domain projection. Request/session/selection/version freshness belongs to the transient inspection cache. Renderer selection, generation consumption and accepted screenplay remain separate existing owners. The shared contract prevents native/tool evidence from diverging.

### Revisit Triggers

Timed relationship validity, a required larger evidence window, or explicitly authorized generation retrieval would require revisiting this read contract and its consumption boundary.

### Traceability Links

- [Contract and plan](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/blob/4c468d6386bcad44117fe7e4439202cdde52a0f7/docs/plans/agent-story-workflows/explicit-bible-recall.md)
- Module READMEs updated: core/contracts, server/src, src-tauri/src and projections, ui/lib, sidebar/bible and stores.
- ADR: N/A; decisions are documented with the module owners.
- [Separate evidence report](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/blob/12a3fa980dd01a389cc11d1c22b7c23cde8092c8/docs/reports/explicit-bible-recall-native.md)
- [Sealed manifest](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/blob/12a3fa980dd01a389cc11d1c22b7c23cde8092c8/docs/reports/explicit-bible-recall-manifest.json)

## Original recall validation and limits (source `8bd0da0`)

The following original evidence retains its original source binding. Local and hosted: **122 core, 511 server, 503 UI tests in 85 files**; strict core/server all-target Clippy, Rust formatting, UI typecheck 0 errors/0 warnings, lint/format/build and traceability. Source drivers: 39; qualifier drivers: 46; no-download admission and 5 regressions pass. Coverage includes >205 nodes/far linked peer, kinds/direction/cycles/caps, separate clocks, temporal withholding/conflict/clear, deletion, atomic WAL reads, unchanged context/text/history and stale frontend responses.

[Native run 37568916076](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/actions/runs/37568916076) / job `112622899670` passed at qualifier `cf9830b6b5df3dc56cd01ab6f8384039a33a0729`, tree `5dcc824866352f3ee8ac198639911b8212c2e252`. Its entire delta from application source is four QA files. [Original artifact 11459778402](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/actions/runs/37568916076/artifacts/11459778402) has ZIP SHA-256 `aebef0fdb00ef2a842201676f22320739f7f2621eb3fc3349a917fdf116f12e5`; all seven original 1920×1440 PNGs were individually inspected and hash-bound to raw metadata/ZIP.

With the graph closed and Bible/timeline/screenplay visible, native controls recall unspecified/999/1000 ms facts, expose snapshot/field sources, save exactly “Mara's umbrella is amber.”, identify affected B, revoke old evidence, explicitly refresh to revision 222, and show a targeted pending proposal. Exact saved manual B and unrelated F draft remain visible and unchanged.

Three production-client localhost HTTP/SSE responses are labelled **synthetic** (generation, recap, preview); recall executes no model. This qualifies transport/context/review behavior, not real-model narrative quality. Acceptance was not clicked; the proposal remains pending. Native capture uses default Both/All filters; other filters are deterministic-test coverage. Native direction/kind select labels are faint against light backgrounds, a recorded visual contrast limitation. Local desktop system libraries are absent; qualification uses the existing hosted GTK/WebKit setup without bypassing ONNX403.

Evidence is separate at `12a3fa980dd01a389cc11d1c22b7c23cde8092c8`; earlier failed/cancelled attempts retain their original bindings and limitations.

## Lifecycle successor validation and limits (source `4c468d6`)

Current source: `4c468d6386bcad44117fe7e4439202cdde52a0f7`, tree `6f546f9d75bffe6baef70912f7635996f6acb244`. Only six UI source/test/README files change from the original source. Ten added regressions bring the full UI suite to **513 tests in 85 files**; all 21 affected tests independently pass. Local lint, format, typecheck (0 errors/0 warnings), production build, Rust formatting, traceability and commit hooks pass. Independent source and native-addendum reviews are accepted.

Separate qualifier: `3cccc2b683903e5ec45531fa990a45043adb524e`, tree `135725a8746492d23c2d15bff38afc2aae2ad8c8`. Its entire delta from current source is eleven allowlisted QA files; production component/store/transport/domain/commands remain byte-identical.

[Native run 37573408905](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/actions/runs/37573408905), job `112636877757`, passed: **122 core, 511 server, 513 UI, 49 driver and 5 no-download tests**, plus strict core/server all-target Clippy and required UI gates. The standard hosted GTK/WebKit and locked Pumas/ORT setup is used; local ONNX403 was not bypassed.

Actual client effects qualify concurrent inspectors, ordinary sidebar close/remount preserving another inspector's evidence, final disposal with delayed success/error, clean same-anchor remount without false notices, and a genuine Bible edit/remount retaining invalidation. The exact ordinary field edit is **“Mara's umbrella is amber.” → “Mara's umbrella is copper.”**; explicit recall then displays revision223. Saved manual screenplay text/revision/placement, the unrelated unsaved draft and every pending-proposal column/status remain unchanged. No Accept action is clicked; the preserved amber proposal predates the copper edit.

This is an **instrumented native host** qualification. Labelled compiled QA controls isolate final disposal/remount without clearing selection and hold completion after the original desktop/domain read succeeds. Success returns the actual read envelope; delayed completion error is labelled **synthetic**. Three authoring HTTP/SSE replies are also labelled synthetic (`real_model:false`). Recall executes no model; this does not establish real-model narrative quality, acceptance after changed facts, or uninstrumented release qualification. The unchanged Rust binary digest alone does not establish UI source identity; the source/qualifier/config bindings and native receipts do. No independent socket-owner enumeration claim is made.

[Artifact 11461888724](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/actions/runs/37573408905/artifacts/11461888724) has untouched ZIP SHA256 `6fd0edf201c76c46c6fff85513c09dccadb8d82665725271464daae87478fb51`. All six original 1920×1440 screenshots were individually inspected and hash-verified against raw metadata and ZIP bytes.

Sealed evidence remains separate and unchanged at **`7566599316cf59ba1457a5d10e0ae0f0b655760e`**:
- [Lifecycle report](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/blob/7566599316cf59ba1457a5d10e0ae0f0b655760e/docs/reports/bible-recall-lifecycle-native.md)
- [Lifecycle manifest](https://github.com/MrScripty/Eidetic/blob/7566599316cf59ba1457a5d10e0ae0f0b655760e/docs/reports/bible-recall-lifecycle-manifest.json), SHA256 `a467d437f39c7621e0324db0f48be29821a87a1e7d90811ae058b2457972a42c`

The report's PR19-at-`8bd0da0` statement records the completed evidence milestone before this separately authorized fast-forward. This publication updates the existing draft PR only; no merge, manual bot-thread resolution or additional CodeRabbit request is included.

## Checklist

- [x] If code under a source root changed, I updated the module README or ADR
- [x] The module README contains required decision sections
- [x] I documented why this design was chosen over alternatives
- [x] I documented invariants and revisit triggers
- [x] I identified the owner of each new policy/state/lifecycle decision
- [x] New abstractions or contracts reduce caller reasoning load
- [x] Tests were added/updated as needed
